newsitem.title: USA: Universal Medical gets $2.2 mln funding.
newsitem.headline: Universal Medical gets $2.2 mln funding.

text.p: Universal Medical Systems Inc said on Friday that it had arranged financing for $2.2 million to support its product development and acquisition plans.
To date, Universal Medical said it has received $1.6 million from the sale of convertible high yield bonds, and $600,000 from debt financing.
The company, a developer of high technology medical diagnostic and treatment systems, said it secured the financing through the private banking firm Select Capital Advisors.
"Discussions are now under way for the next level of funding requirements, primarily for additional acquisitions," the company said.
